subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: Service With a Smile (Listening & Speaking)
lesson: Vocabulary matching and Listening 3.4.2: training to be a chef
outcomes: Match key words such as 'day release' and 'prospects' with their meanings
Predict information and listen to complete a table about a chef's course

tf.why: The listening gives the time as 9.30.

tf.s: Hassan can take the certificate course for advanced chefs.
tf.why: This is the course that suits his experience.

tf.s: The chef's course lasts three years.
'Day release' means attending the Institute one day a week while continuing in a job.
tf.why: Students keep working and study one day each week.

tf.s: Hassan wants a formal qualification so he can apply for a job in a five-star international hotel.
tf.why: A qualification helps him get a top hotel job.

tf.s: The prospects for chefs in Oman are poor because restaurants are closing.
tf.why: Prospects are excellent: new hotels and restaurants open all the time.

tf.s: The training kitchen is one of the facilities at the Institute.
tf.why: Facilities are the places and equipment for training.
'Prospects' are chances of success in the future.

tf.s: An 'overview' is a very detailed study of one small point.
tf.why: An overview is a general description of the whole thing.

tf.s: 'Facilities' means the people who teach on a course.
tf.why: Facilities are the buildings and equipment, like a training kitchen.

boxes.why: Day release means one day a week at the Institute.

mcq.q: A table gap says 'Length of course: ___'. What type of information do you predict?
o: A length of time, like 18 months
mcq.why: 'Length' tells you to listen for a period of time.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: 'With so many new hotels, the job ___ for chefs are excellent.'
mcq.why: 'Prospects' means future chances, here for jobs.

Because he has never cooked before

mcq.q: Why are the prospects for chefs in Oman excellent?
o: New hotels and restaurants open all the time and need chefs
There are too many chefs already
mcq.why: Growth in tourism creates demand for chefs.

mcq.q: Why is it useful to predict the type of information before you listen?
o: You know exactly what to listen for, such as a time or a number
You will not need to listen at all
It tells you the speaker's name
mcq.why: Predicting helps you focus and catch the answers.
